title: Trek — Deep Space
tagline: Clear the galaxy of hostile ships before time runs out.
teaser: A turn-based command of the last ship in a sector of deep space. Type your orders, share your energy between shields, engines and weapons, chart the galaxy quadrant by quadrant, and clear it of hostile ships before the stardates run out. Every star, ship and sound is generated by code.

manPage.synopsis: trek — navigate the galaxy, manage energy, win the campaign.
manPage.description: Eric Allman’s turn-based space command game, one of the earliest programs in the BSD games directory.

howToPlay: Type commands like “move”, “phaser” or “torpedo”; ? opens help.
Scan, warp between quadrants and dock to refuel and repair.
Clear every hostile ship before time runs out.
